08-audio-spectral
Audio Spectral Heuristic Flow

Upload audio
Identify signature; enforce bounded input

decode_media: local FFmpeg
Up to 30 s; mono PCM WAV at 44.1 kHz

AudioSpectralAcousticDetector
Read samples; select channel; normalize amplitude

SciPy real FFT
Energy above 8 kHz; spectral flatness

Apply abrupt-band-cutoff rule
Sample rate >= 22050 Hz
High-frequency energy ratio < 0.001

Return heuristic evidence and limitations
Calibrated authenticity confidence unavailable
Not a trained voice-clone detector; no verified real/fake verdict.
